training_sources: new agent-authored train-only intent and OOS banks
validation: Separate newly authored intent questions and OOS families. No random split of augmented questions.

model_grid.features: word (1,2) plus char_wb (3,5) TF-IDF; fit on training only

rejection_calibration.selection: Maximize correctly accepted ID / all ID subject to validation OOS FAR <= 5%; tie break fewer wrong accepted ID, higher validation closed-set macro-F1, smaller C, stricter domain then gap threshold. If no nonzero-coverage feasible candidate, report calibration failed; no test-driven fallback.

leakage_audit: Normalized exact overlap forbidden across train/validation/fresh test. Same authored family belongs to only one split. Character-ngram cosine >= 0.85 is quarantined or excluded from primary fresh-test scores. Prior evaluation questions never enter train or validation. Full audit saved before fitting.
test: Freeze fresh test checksum before fitting; train command cannot read test questions. Separate evaluation command after artifact/threshold freeze. Score unchanged grouped-60-v1 and new candidate on identical eligible test ID/OOS records. No further model selection, threshold tuning or corpus editing after seeing fresh-test predictions.
metrics: per-class recall with rejection as error
deployment: CANDIDATE only. No automatic approval, activation or modification to existing registry entries. Synthetic labels are not human review. Preserve all speech files and do not load speech or TensorFlow components.
